text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A consortium of German and U.S. investors will look into the possible investment up to $100 million in different sectors in Bahrain.
- An Indian delegation seeking to attract investment from Indians working abroad will visit Bahrain this week.
- Technical colleges are needed in Bahrain to prepare Bahrainis for private sector jobs, the chairman of a Bahraini investment company said.
- A Bahraini team leaves for Germany to attend an education conference there.
- Health and safety officials of Gulf Arab states are to meet on Sunday in Bahrain.
